name: Change tab title and icon
plain: Changes the tab title and icon at any time, including while the tab is in the background.
meaning: A site can animate the title, add unread counts, or swap the favicon. It is a no-prompt way to draw attention from a hidden tab; scammers also use it to mimic other sites.

access.revocation: Nothing to revoke (no permission is stored)
access.iframe: Frames cannot change the top document title
steps: Script sets document.title or the icon href
App badge needs an installed PWA (Chrome desktop 81)

limits.headline: Can change its tab name and small icon at any time
limits.user_action: Nothing. It happens as you use the page, even when the tab is hidden.
can: Change the tab name, such as to show a new message count
Swap the small icon in the tab
Change them even when you are in another tab
cannot: Change the title or icon of other sites or tabs
Change what is in your bookmarks without you saving it
Hide the real site address in the address bar

story.what_it_is: A page can change its tab name, icon and badge, even when you are looking elsewhere.

marketing.name: Badging API
marketing.pitch: Chrome's docs say the badging API lets an installed web app show a number on its icon.

story.for_you: Your tab shows '(3) Inbox' or blinks a dot when something new arrives. You feel pulled back to check it, even though you never asked for alerts.
story.for_makers: Makers use it as a free attention nudge: unread counts, call status, game turns. It works without any permission, so it reaches everyone.

use_cases.example: Your mail tab shows an unread count and flashes when a new email arrives.
A live auction tab shows 'Outbid!' in its title so you notice.
A browser strategy game flashes 'Your turn' in the tab title.
A video call shows who is speaking in the tab icon.
A shady site changes its title and icon to look like a bank or a warning.
A project tool shows a spinner icon while it saves.

technical_bounds: No limit on title length in the DOM; tab strips truncate to about the first 20 to 40 characters
Favicon cache may delay updates (Chrome, Safari cache aggressively)
Badging API works only for installed apps in Chrome and Safari 17 Home Screen web apps; no prompt in installed apps for the numeric badge but notifications permission is needed on iOS
Page cannot flash the taskbar or play a system sound without media or notification permission

abuse: Tab title swap after the person leaves (tabnabbing)

history.change: Badging API for installed PWAs on desktop
